span.p:
trajectory_text() — the single canonical serialization
describes the window by shape, quantized against fixed per-metric ranges:
trend · level decile · peak · volatility · form

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Two windows differing only by jitter serialize identically
and therefore embed identically, while two archetypes never collide.
Raw samples would make noise look like a different failure.

the production path · 1024 dimensions by default, not 1536

span.p: demo/seed_manifest.json records which provider built the world

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
They are different vector spaces. A database seeded with one and
queried with the other yields meaningless distances that still look
like distances. Switching providers requires a full re-seed — which is
why the manifest exists and why the seeder refuses to be ambiguous.

svg.text: NEXUS — one ruler, or every distance is measured differently
